lines.text: Alex wants to understand a difficult topic.
The chatbot sounds confident. But the answer is wrong.
The video? Good luck finding the right moment.
What if Alex could just... ask the video?
One click, on almost any video site. No captions? VidSeek writes them.
Ask anything. Get a clear answer, with the exact moments behind it.
Click a moment, and you're right there.
Curious what everyone else thought? It reads the comments, too.
Ask a follow-up. Then another. Go as deep as you want.
And it doesn't just listen. It watches.
It even reads the slides, and what's written on the board.
Every video lands in your own library. Searchable, and always one click away.
VidSeek AI. Ask any video anything.
